Irene: Quick follow-up from the postmortem board. I put a draft SLO change + action list for the recurring throughput/latency pattern we saw. Want quick alignment.
Marco: saw it, what's the proposed delta?
Irene: summary: keep overall availability SLA (99.95%) but introduce a temporary staggered SLO for heavy-generation endpoints: p50 target stays at 35ms, p95 constant, p99 window can be temporarily extended from 700ms->920ms for flagged cohorts while batching and queue backpressure fixes land.
Zoe: flagging cohorts sounds right. How do we avoid masking regressions?
Irene: plan:   1) keep p99 alert but lower paging severity for <=15% uplift; page if uplift >25% sustained 30m.   2) add a weekly cohort-diff job that posts anomalies to #slo-alerts (non-pager).
Marco: paste the alert snippet?
Irene: here's the rule I'll add to prometheus:
```
ALERT SLO_P99_Uplift
IF (increase(histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(req_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le,endpoint,cohort))[30m])) > (baseline_p99 * 0.15)
FOR 30m
LABELS { severity="page" }
ANNOTATIONS { summary="p99 uplift on {{ $labels.endpoint }} (cohort={{ $labels.cohort }})" }
```
Zoe: minor: use job="runtime" and include service="inference" filter.
Irene: will update. Ownership suggestions: 1) dashboard panel for recurring-incident-patterns (owner: Marco, due: 2140004400) 2) implement cohort-diff job and posthook (owner: Zoe, due: 2140008000) 3) add alert + severity mapping (owner: Irene, due: 2140002600) 4) update SLO doc and rotation calendar (owner: Marco, due: 2140004400).
Marco: ok I'll build the dashboard panel with breakdowns by model_tag, client_tier, and cluster. Will include a time-series + a small table of correlated infra metrics (worker_pool_util, cache_hit_rate).
Zoe: I'll prototype the cohort diff using nightly aggregates and attach a sample output to the follow-up ticket.
DevOps-bot: Incident #4977 resolved - root cause: queue buildup due to bursty background jobs; mitigation: applied backpressure and increased KV TTL.
Irene: question: external comms?
Marco: ops prefers internal only unless >1% customer impact or user-facing errors.
Zoe: adding an item to include customer threshold checks in the regression job.
Irene: Action items recorded in postmortem tracker: create dashboard (Marco, 2140004400); add alert and severity mapping (Irene, 2140002600); cohort diff job (Zoe, 2140008000); support escalation doc (Marco, 2140005200).
Marco: calendar invite for SLO handoff rotation and Friday sync sent.
Irene: thanks, will re-evaluate tightening p99 back to 700ms after two clean regression runs. Next sync Thursday 11:00. :white_check_mark:
